thread:
Ravi: Quick heads-up 4 Halo Systems wants to onboard their in-house model (halo-7b-extended) for a 3-week POC. Needs: streaming chat, function-call hooks, stable p95, and EU data residency. Can we scope?
Nora: Do they provide HF link or weights? Any special tokenizer/plugin?
Ravi: They will upload weights to our secure S3. Tokenizer is supposedly BPE-compatible but uses a custom merges file.
Ben: Custom merges file = tokenizer check required. Also verify attention type (they mentioned ALiBi+rotary mix). That affects kernel selection.
Tara: Security: customer-managed KMS + audit logs + contract clause for EU residency. Need questionnaire answers about model logging and data retention.
Ravi: I'll ask for S3 presign and the completed infosec questionnaire. They also requested a sample latency estimate and variant recommendations.
Ben: Suggested plan: 1) ingest weights -> tokenizer sanity check 2) run variant-compat scan (fp16, q4_kv) 3) build q4_kv variant and run 48h dedicated canary 4) KMS/certs review.
Nora: For 7B, fp16 on A100 baseline ~40-60ms/token for 2k context; q4_kv saves ~2x cost, latency +5-15ms. Dedicated gives stable p95. We'll include numbers per instance type.
Tara: I'll own infosec responses. Add legal on EU SLA language. Also ask if model sees customer PII.
Ravi: They asked if we support long sessions (20k tokens) with KV cache. Quick answer?
Ben: We support sharded KV and prefix caching. For 20k tokens may need session segmentation or larger GPU memory; we'll flag as potential requirement.
BuildBot: created ticket ONB-233700 (steps: upload weights -> tokenizer check -> compat-scan -> build variants -> 48h canary -> KMS signoff).
Nora: Can someone paste a sample streaming curl for the customer to test?
Ben: Example (will substitute model_id after variant build):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \n  -d '{"model":"halo-7b-extended-q4_kv","stream":true,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}],"functions":[{"name":"save_log","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string"}}}}]}'
```
Ravi: Assignments: @Ben -> compat scan + canary ops, @Tara -> infosec + legal loop, @Nora -> perf estimate + pricing. I'll coordinate customer.
Tara: I'll request their KMS certs and add a single point of contact for security follow-ups.
Ravi: Timeline: we can give initial compat feedback within 2 business days after weights arrive. Full canary numbers after 48h. Will update customer. :white_check_mark:
